title: Canvas selection frames come from one shared helper, not per-page markup
goal: When a mock page shows something selected on the canvas, the selection outline, its corner handles and its size tag are hand-drawn again on every page, and five pages this cycle described a selection in their caption while drawing nothing at all. This makes a page declare that something is selected and get the standard selection drawn for it, and adds a check that catches a page whose words and picture disagree.
notes: Recurring finding: five separate tasks this cycle each fixed the same defect by hand (walk, composites, img-retouch-wt, icon-gradient-wt, and the six video walkthroughs all promised a selection in copy but drew no ring on canvas). The markup is identical every time: .selwrap > .sel-ring + 4 .handle + .mtag. Extract it into a shared helper (a data-attribute the shell honors, like data-sel-frame on the target, mirroring how data-shell builds chrome) so a page declares selection instead of retyping it, and add an audit gate that fails any page whose copy claims a selection while the canvas has no ring. Acceptance: helper shipped in shared/components, at least three pages converted to it with identical rendering, and the audit gate catches a deliberately broken page.
acceptance: A page can mark something as selected and get the outline, corner handles and size tag drawn for it without hand-writing any of them
At least three pages that used to hand-draw a selection use the shared version and render identically before and after
The automated page check fails a deliberately broken page whose caption claims a selection but whose canvas shows none

log.note: Helper shipped: data-sel-frame in shared/components/selection.js builds .sel-ring + 4 corner .handles + .mtag in the canonical order, idempotently, and re-runs on mutation so walkthrough-created selections are upgraded too. Value is the tag text; an authored .mtag inside the host is kept (and moved last) so pages that retag by id via data-set still work. data-sel-parts takes edges / rotate / none. Deliberately does NOT touch positioning: seven pages hang the frame on an empty wrapper inside the object box, and adding .selwrap there would have moved every one of those rings.

Converted 4 pages (7 frames): walk (#selCallout), composites (#selFrame, #selList), img-retouch-wt (#selFrame), icon-gradient-wt (#selPlate,#selGlyph,#selSib). 29 hand-written .handle/.mtag elements deleted. Rendering verified identical in Chrome: ring/handle/tag rects relative to the host, computed border+radius+position, data-sel bucket, data-mtag side and child order all byte-identical before vs after across all 7 frames.

Gate shipped: shared/check-selection.mjs. Gate A - a canvas page whose walkthrough lights a Layers row (.lrow) must draw a frame. Gate B - copy that names the ring on the canvas must draw one, with narrow phrasing so a spec page discussing selection owes nothing. Gate C - ratchet on hand-drawn frames (81, may only go down). Validated against history: it CATCHES walk@4c3242d^ and composites@a1ecfb1^ (the two real defects) and passes both after their fixes. --self-test runs it over shared/fixtures/, including a deliberately broken page.

data-sel-frame ships in shared/components/selection.js: a page declares the selection on the object's box and the ring, four corner grabs and size tag are built for it (data-sel-parts adds edges/rotate, or none for a bare ring; an authored .mtag keeps its id so data-set retagging still works). Four pages converted, seven frames, 29 hand-written elements deleted: walk, composites, img-retouch-wt, icon-gradient-wt. Rendering verified identical in Chrome before vs after on all seven frames (rects, computed border/radius/position, data-sel bucket, data-mtag side, child order), and every walkthrough stepped end to end plus Reset with frames showing, hiding and retagging exactly as before. New gate shared/check-selection.mjs fails a canvas page whose walkthrough lights a Layers row or whose copy names the ring while drawing nothing, plus a ratchet on hand-drawn frames (81, downward only); run against history it catches walk@4c3242d^ and composites@a1ecfb1^ and passes both after their fixes, and --self-test proves it on shared/fixtures/ including a page built to be wrong. Full-study browser sweep over 90 pages clean; elevation and state gates green. Commits 34816dc + 7223661 pushed to main. Follow-up filed: the-multi-selection-specimen-draws-its-own-group.
